name: Boris Sofman
profile: Carnegie Mellon robotics PhD who co-founded consumer-robotics company Anki (Anki Drive, Cozmo) in 2010, then spent ~5 years at Waymo leading its autonomous trucking program. In 2024 he co-founded Bedrock Robotics, which retrofits excavators with sensors and ML to run autonomously; it raised a 600M USD Series C in Oct 2026 at a 4.1B USD valuation.
interesting_fact: Data centers are a priority market for Bedrock: Sofman cites roughly 170B USD/yr of US data-center construction, much of it on remote, off-grid sites that need massive earthworks - Inc. framed it as 'The AI boom has a dirt problem'.
deep_cut_fact: His 2010 CMU PhD thesis, 'Online Learning Techniques for Improving Robot Navigation in Unfamiliar Domains' (advisors Drew Bagnell and Tony Stentz), taught off-road robots to predict terrain traversal costs from overhead imagery - a direct ancestor of today's autonomous dirt-moving.
notes: Very media-friendly (MCJ/Inevitable, Automate podcast ep. 66 Nov 2026). Strong data-center/energy angle. Quote: 'If you're too soon, there's no prize for being there 10 years early.' Avoid dwelling on Anki's 2019 shutdown.

name: Chris Taylor
current_role: Listed as founder of Aalyria (Google spinout; ~1B USD valuation); CEO title not re-verified this session
profile: Aalyria, the company he is listed as founding, was spun out of Google to commercialise the network-orchestration software ('Spacetime', formerly codenamed 'Minkowski' / the Loon SDN) that ran Google's Loon stratospheric-balloon internet network in production for three years, plus laser-communication technology. It targets satellite, aerospace and 5G non-terrestrial networks, including US defence customers.
interesting_fact: Aalyria's Spacetime software orchestrated Loon's balloon mesh network for three years, serving hundreds of thousands of users - a network Aalyria says was in many ways more complex than the largest LEO satellite constellations because balloons move far less predictably than satellites.
notes: Common name; Aalyria's site has no leadership page and web-search quota ran out, so his title/background could not be verified in this session. Company press inbox is the best route.
